preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 500,000.
There must be exactly n-1 edges in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid nodes within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: len(decorations) == n and all(0 <= a <= n for a in decorations)
preconditions.description: The decorations array must contain n elements, each between 0 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of possible configurations modulo 1000000007.
The result must be a non-negative integer.
